title: A timing mismatch changes feature availability
method: Synthetic replay: 980/1,000 training rows contain the feature, but only 760/1,000 serving requests receive it before the deadline. The 22-percentage-point gap is availability, not a model accuracy difference.
alt: A timing mismatch changes feature availability. Training export: 98 percent of 1,000 records, Serving before deadline: 76 percent of 1,000 records. Illustrative data.
